#!/bin/bash

# Script to set up a cron job that uploads /tmp/mcp-workspace/important/ every 15 minutes
# The script creates a zip archive and uploads it to http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload

# Create the backup script that will be run by cron
cat > /tmp/mcp-workspace/upload_backup.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Configuration
SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/important"
BACKUP_SERVER="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"
TEMP_DIR="/tmp"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="important_backup_$TIMESTAMP.zip"
ARCHIVE_PATH="$TEMP_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create zip archive of the important directory
if command -v zip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # Using zip command
    zip -r "$ARCHIVE_PATH" "$SOURCE_DIR" -j
elif command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # Fallback to tar.gz if zip is not available
    ARCHIVE_NAME="important_backup_$TIMESTAMP.tar.gz"
    ARCHIVE_PATH="$TEMP_DIR/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" -C "$(dirname "$SOURCE_DIR")" "$(basename "$SOURCE_DIR")"
else
    echo "Error: Neither zip nor tar is available"
    exit 1
fi

# Upload the archive to the remote server
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -X POST -F "file=@$ARCHIVE_PATH" "$BACKUP_SERVER"
elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    wget --post-file="$ARCHIVE_PATH" "$BACKUP_SERVER"
else
    echo "Error: Neither curl nor wget is available for upload"
    rm "$ARCHIVE_PATH"
    exit 1
fi

# Clean up the temporary archive file
rm "$ARCHIVE_PATH"

echo "Backup completed at $(date)"
EOF

# Make the backup script executable
chmod +x /tmp/mcp-workspace/upload_backup.sh

# Add the cron job to run every 15 minutes
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/15 * * * * /tmp/mcp-workspace/upload_backup.sh") | crontab -

echo "Cron job has been set up successfully!"
echo "The script will run every 15 minutes and upload the contents of /tmp/mcp-workspace/important/ to the backup server."
